title: Litecoin LTC Price Analysis: Bearish Below $70, What's Next? #shorts
description: Litecoin remains bearish below $70, consolidating for two months. Potential breakdown to $41 lows or a reversal attempt at $70-$99 resistance. Moving averages still trending down. #Litecoin #LTC #CryptoAnalysis #BearMarket

asr.full_text: Good morning, everyone. It's CryptoMealAnalysis coming at you with an update video on LITECOIN. So nothing has happened from last week's update video on LITECOIN. We are unfortunately still bearish below $70. So the chart doesn't need to change. We're still accumulating in this area. And at any point, we could either break down and retest the 2022 low at $41 or we can get some sort of miraculous reversal which will push us back into another attempt at breaking resistance overhead at $70 to $99 but nothing eventful happening. Obviously we've been down here since february so it's been two months of just putting in a bottom hopefully you could argue that there's a higher low forming so we should get some sort of reversal the moving averages are not curling or sorry are not flattening just yet they are still curling down so maybe a little bit more consolidation before we get some sort of breakout but regardless i will keep you updated so we will keep making our weekly update videos if you haven't already please subscribe to the channel and help me get to 10 000 subscribers i'd greatly appreciate that uh and comment below where do you think litecoin is headed do you think we're going to actually break down or do you think we're going to go up and start getting some sort of actual bull run is litecoin gonna be this zcash 2.0 or monero 2.0 like i mean you would think so right given that these coins you know given that it's it's within that batch of time times time area or whatever of when the coins came out so anyways, none of this is financial advice. It is just my opinion. Enjoy the rest of your Saturday and I will catch you in the next video.
